releasePlan.notes: Roles: shift2-enable-greeting-refresh-error-rate = killswitch; shift2-enable-greeting-refresh-latency = pause (two-armed - the page handler's server-side render duration is emitted on control and v1 alike); shift2-enable-greeting-refresh-success-rate = monitoring (one-armed by construction, since control renders no refresh button). The error metric is also one-armed and is fed only by the v1 beacon, so the first failed refresh trips the killswitch with no control comparison - see the CORS finding in the review. The project has no autogenerated otel* metrics, and the global sentry-errors-* metrics are backend-only (only the Flask service initializes Sentry), so neither can guard this frontend flag.
